title: plan_ops__block_dependents input
description: Cascade `blocked` status onto dependents of a failed task. Mutates the plan markdown (single read, single write) and appends `blocked` run-log events.

failed.description: Task id whose failure triggers the cascade

update_schedule_state.description: Path to the schedule JSON. After a successful cascade, atomically populates `state.blocked` with the cascaded task ids.
